instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Also, when you draw a card marked UR or higher, a bonus called Jackpot starts. Then you can keep opening packs. You are happy about one rare card, and then you get more time to open packs. Your willpower is just getting up to say, all right, time to review, then just one more pulls at its sleeve. What may happen here is not that you stop liking English words. Instead, the reason for your interest may change. First, you draw a card because you want to learn. Then, you look at words because you want to draw a card. You may still be looking at the same cards, but the person in charge inside your mind has changed. The study worker is no longer in charge. The treasure hunter is. But here is something to mark in red: a rare word does not have to be high on your study list. Rarity is the game's way to sort words. It sorts them by how often people use them. I'm glad I drew it, is one thought. I should learn it first, is another. Even if a word shines, it should not get special treatment in your study order.
